new_input: Root assignment under user source-71d986 authorizes ordinary current participating-source contract derivation only; no old perf fixture/body operation or generic/exec replay is authorized.
original_scope: M14-03-05 credentials/limits/scheduling, SHM/perf/file wrappers, validation and forwarding. This packet covers exact current sys_perf_event_open plus12B offload callback versus genuine existing Rust entry/body and participating descriptor ownership.

profile.held_owned_fork_and_generic_exec_modes: No flag changes, no entry into held590e/TID/exec/replay modes

public_abi.entry: long sys_perf_event_open(int n, ihk_mc_user_context_t *ctx); n is not used by current body, syscall table x86 number298 selects this C entry.
public_abi.offload_callback: long (*)(struct syscall_request *, int cpu); current C perf_event_open_do_syscall_bridge returns genuine do_syscall(request,cpu) unchanged; Rust type PerfOpenSyscallFn = unsafe extern C fn(*mut SyscallRequest,CInt)->CLong.
public_abi.arguments: ctx arg0 user attr address, arg1 narrowed C int pid, arg2 narrowed C int validation cpu, arg3 narrowed C int group_fd, arg4 unsigned-long flags. Actual offload cpu is ihk_mc_get_processor_id(), separate from validation cpu.

request.genuine_layout: SyscallRequest size72 align8; current C stack declaration also IHK_DMA_ALIGN. Valid/rtid/ttid remain owned by genuine offload preparation/publication, not invented by the perf wrapper.
request.defined_payload: Current C and Rust Linux-FD helper both set number=perf_event_open_nr and all six args=0. The selected real Rust act_perf_event_open ignores its wait/request pointer and invokes the no-arg provider; provider currently opens /dev/null read-only and returns its actual signed result through do_syscall_return. Existing accepted wire correction is reused; no need to replay it.

descriptor.Rust: repr(C) Mckfd size80; fd8,data16,read_cb32,dup_cb72. Rust padding at12 is the C sig_no storage, not a kind or refcount. Existing genuine C offset tables supply all addresses.
descriptor.kind: No current explicit semantic kind/generation/reference/closing state in this ABI. fd equality and an arbitrary CLong data value do not prove a live mc_perf_event.
descriptor.nullable_callbacks: Existing helpers accept Option<unsafe extern C fn> at exact C callback widths; public provider and offset guards must be validated before allocating or publishing any new resource.

public_abi.event: Real mc_perf_event has copied perf_event_attr, hardware/extra-reg state, counter_id, atomic64 count (counter value), child_count_total, pmc_status, parent/group_leader/sibling/group lists and nr_siblings. count is explicitly measurement data, not a lifetime reference. No reinterpretation of count/opt/unused fields is permitted without a new actual ABI/owner contract.
public_abi.attribute: Reuse exact real PerfEventAttr from f03_perf_event_attr_abi.rs and genuine mc_perf_event.h. Full actual size usercopy must succeed before typed/bitfield reads; do not invent another Linux-header approximation.

ordered_actual_success_path.operation: Use current CPU-local thread and thread->proc, borrow original live ctx; full-sized attr copy_from_user into private stack storage.
ordered_actual_success_path.obligation: Keep ctx/thread/proc and stack request/attribute live through the synchronous call; copy failure returns -EFAULT before event allocation.

Preserve current branch order: cpu>0 or flags>0/unsupported type/unsupported read-format/frequency gives -ENOENT; nonfrequency negative/sign-bit sample-period returns -EINVAL even if another unsupported flag was seen. cpu<=0 domain is retained; no new pid/group restrictions.

ordered_actual_success_path.operation: Allocate unpublished event, initialize its whole bytes to zero, copy attr, initialize actual lists/count/hardware fields and map/init using genuine providers.
ordered_actual_success_path.obligation: Allocator/init failure returns exact signed status; existing event allocation helper frees its own event on mapping/init failure. Successful event ownership passes only to current open transaction, never a fabricated pin.

ordered_actual_success_path.operation: Set event.pid, invoke genuine x86 ihk_mc_perfctr_alloc, save counter_id.
ordered_actual_success_path.obligation: Current x86 provider scans thread.pmc_alloc_map for a zero bit; it selects an index and does not reserve it. Current open sets the map only after successful host-FD return. A new concurrency contract must define real reservation and which thread owns it; no count-as-reference or assumed early reservation.

ordered_actual_success_path.operation: If group_fd=-1, make event its own group leader/status0; else resolve group_fd from proc.mckfd, take its data as leader, append group_entry and increment nr_siblings. OR selected counter bit into chosen leader.pmc_status.
ordered_actual_success_path.obligation: Preserve all originally supported valid group descriptor values. Establish actual descriptor kind, live owner and retained group reservation before interpreting data. Serialize mutation with close/group mutation and retain leader throughout later offload/publication. Do not restrict to group_fd=-1 or leader-only as a shortcut.

ordered_actual_success_path.operation: Write exact perf request number and all six zero args; synchronously call genuine do_syscall on actual current CPU. On fd>=0 set thread pmc map bit.
ordered_actual_success_path.obligation: Release IRQ-save descriptor/group locks before offload. Retain real references/reservations while it waits. Propagate signed negative results exactly, no unsigned conversion, duplicate call or invented errno transformation.

ordered_actual_success_path.operation: Allocate descriptor, initialize fd/sig_no=-1/data=event and actual read/ioctl/mmap/close/fcntl callbacks, then insert under proc.mckfd_lock and return fd.
ordered_actual_success_path.obligation: Define all later-consumed descriptor state, including opt/dup ownership, before visibility. Current publish helper writes neither opt nor dup_cb and its allocator signature does not promise zeroed descriptor storage; this contract does not assume an unobserved allocator guarantee. Publication establishes one explicit descriptor->event ownership edge.

actual_participating_lifetime_paths.source: kernel/rust/syscall_policy.rs:syscall_mckfd_find_locked plus syscall_read/ioctl/fcntl and do_mmap descriptor paths
actual_participating_lifetime_paths.actual: Finds under proc.mckfd_lock but unlocks before returning raw descriptor and invoking callback.
actual_participating_lifetime_paths.required: Acquire an explicit live descriptor/event operation reference under the same lookup exclusion before pointer escape; release only after the real callback. A pin added inside perf callback is already too late for descriptor storage.

actual_participating_lifetime_paths.actual: Unlink/next=null under proc lock, unlock, invoke close_cb then free descriptor and forward Linux close.
actual_participating_lifetime_paths.required: Remove lookup visibility atomically, consume one close state, defer descriptor/event frees until real in-flight/group references retire. Preserve external close ordering/return and no double callback/free.

actual_participating_lifetime_paths.actual: Read event from descriptor.data, clear current-thread pmc/extra map bits and directly free event; no member unlink, leader reparent or reference decrement.
actual_participating_lifetime_paths.required: Define counter lease owner across threads/fork and group leader/member edges. Counter bits are allocation state, not lifetime. Close must release exactly its actual ownership without invalidating another real descriptor or member.

actual_participating_lifetime_paths.source: kernel/rust/process_helpers.rs:current selected process clone loop plus process_mckfd_copy_body_result
actual_participating_lifetime_paths.actual: Holds child proc.mckfd_lock, walks parent list and shallow-copies full80-byte descriptor, pushes child descriptor, then only afterwards calls an optional dup callback.
actual_participating_lifetime_paths.required: Acquire live source descriptor/event under parent lookup exclusion BEFORE copying. Define actual inherited ownership/counter/group semantics and rollback; a postcopy dup callback alone cannot protect the source. No generic descriptor-size/layout change is assumed.

actual_participating_lifetime_paths.actual: Final-VM path holds process mckfd_lock while invoking each callback with ctx=null. Nodes are drained/freed through later real process cleanup.
actual_participating_lifetime_paths.required: Close must support both after-unlock ordinary close and under-lock VM teardown with no recursive same-lock acquisition or waiting for pins while locked. Last-owner destruction/defer and descriptor drain must honor the same live-reference protocol.
